settings.name: YouTube History (Watch History and Search History)
settings.description: YouTube Watch History and Search History are managed under your Google Account, not YouTube settings. Pausing Watch History stops new videos from being saved to your history. Pausing Search History stops YouTube searches from being saved. Both histories are used by YouTube's recommendation algorithm and by Google's advertising systems.
settings.whatItDoesnt: Pausing does not delete existing history. YouTube continues using engagement signals (pause, skip, rewind) within the current session for real-time recommendations. Pausing YouTube history does not pause your broader Web & App Activity, which continues to log YouTube visits at the Google level.

settings.name: Ad Personalization (Google Account Level)
settings.description: Because YouTube is a Google product, ad personalization is controlled at the Google Account level, not within YouTube. Turning off ad personalization in your Google Account stops behavioral targeting across YouTube, Search, Gmail, and the Display Network simultaneously.
settings.whatItDoesnt: Turning off ad personalization does not remove YouTube from Google's data collection. Your viewing history, search queries, and engagement behavior continue to be recorded. You will see contextual ads — ads based on the content of the video you are watching — rather than ads based on your behavioral history.

settings.name: YouTube Activity Used Across Google Products
settings.description: YouTube watch history and search behavior are included in Web & App Activity and shared across Google products. A YouTube search for a medical symptom can influence ads you see in Gmail. A YouTube binge of home renovation content can appear as targeting parameters for home improvement advertisers in Google Search.
settings.whatItDoesnt: Pausing Web & App Activity stops the cross-product data sharing. It does not stop YouTube from using your current session behavior for recommendations within YouTube.

settings.name: Location (for Recommendations and Ads)
settings.description: YouTube uses your location (from device GPS, IP address, or Google Account location settings) to serve local content, local ads, and adjust recommendations by region. Location is not a separate toggle within YouTube — it is governed by your Google Account's location settings and your device's location permissions for the YouTube app.
settings.whatItDoesnt: Revoking location permission from the YouTube app stops GPS-based location from reaching YouTube. IP-based location inference continues regardless of app permissions and cannot be disabled at the app level.

settings.name: Connected Apps with YouTube Access
settings.description: Third-party services authenticated via Google or YouTube OAuth may have access to YouTube account data, including watch history, subscriptions, and playlist management. Review connected apps periodically to revoke access from services no longer in use.
settings.whatItDoesnt: Revoking access removes future permissions. It does not delete data that the third-party service has already collected.

settings.name: Autoplay
settings.description: Autoplay is a recommendation algorithm feature, not a data collection setting. It continuously feeds you recommended content based on your viewing history. While it does not directly affect data collection, it is the mechanism by which YouTube viewing sessions extend and engagement data accumulates.
settings.whatItDoesnt: Turning off Autoplay stops the automatic progression to the next video. It does not reduce data collection during videos you choose to watch.
